GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back near last 13l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, battled on well but never a threat # even effort
Just Ok drifted back rail 6l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well with limited room # hit line well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from the 400m until near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from a low draw. Settled Down Two Wide 6th, 5 Lengths @ 1000m. fanned Four Wide Straightening Up all Clear . had chance Battled away reasonably. peaked 100m # outgunned
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after becoming fractious and lifting its off-hind leg up on the running board for a short period of time and was deemed to race. Passing the 900m, raced keenly and had to be steadied to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair eased back 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well making good ground, limited room very late # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden more conservatively; settled off midfield. Over the concluding stages could not be fully ridden out when placed in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1200m became unbalanced when bumped. Approaching the 400m was buffeted between runners. Rdr reported that the gelding travelled well in the heavy going through the early and middle stages however came under pressure rounding the home turn and failed to close off in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no significant abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, had zero luck in straight, see again # forgive/forget

Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th Outside 5 Lengths enjoyed good trail was held-up in between runners x 500m, but into Clear Turning for home and then couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the gelding raced flat and, in his view, had come to the end of its preparation. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr concurred with the comments of rdr and advised the gelding will now be spelled.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, taken across and Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 5 Lengths Two Wide approaching turn, shifted Four Wide at 400m, out to centre of track Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead at the 80m while getting wider and wider latter stages # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 2-3 wide, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out widest Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead at the 100m, drew clear and kept going to post. Always had them covered. # solid win
